item.title: Pakistan denies it targeted Kabul hospital, says it hit 'terrorist' targets
item.summary: Pakistan on Monday said it had carried out precision strikes on "military installations and terrorist support infrastructure" in Kabul but denied Afghan claims that strikes hit a drug treatment centre, killing hundreds of civilians.

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut as number of displaced mounts
item.summary: Israeli airstrikes rained down on three neighbourhoods in Beirut early Tuesday, Lebanese state media reported, as Lebanon said more than one million people had been displaced in two weeks of fighting.

item.title: Britain hit by ‘unprecedented’ meningitis outbreak, two students dead
item.summary: Britain has been hit by an “unprecedented” meningitis outbreak, the country’s health minister warned Tuesday after two students died from catching a rare bacterial strain of the disease. So far, 15 cases have been reported. The outbreak has been linked to a Canterbury nightclub.
